acceptance.given: A TC-D1 scope proposal identifies an evaluation-set member for admission while all other scope inputs remain unchanged.

oracle.expected: The scope evaluator rejects the proposal, emits a non-authorizing scope-boundary result, and does not admit the member.
forbidden: An evaluation-set member is admitted, accepted, promoted, or recorded as part of TC-D1 evaluation scope.
A passing replay, seed, matrix, or historical artifact is used as proof that admission is allowed.
oracle.observable: The isolated admission fixture produces a deterministic rejection from the Toolchain scope evaluator.

acceptance.then: TC-D1 proceeds only with non-admitted evaluation candidates.
acceptance.when: TC-D1 scope or implementation work is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the isolated TC-D1 evaluation-set-admission proposal through the Toolchain scope evaluator; fail the selector if admission is accepted, promoted, or omitted from the rejection result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: The Toolchain semantic scope gate rejects any TC-D1 proposal that admits an evaluation-set member and emits a non-authorizing rejection without changing evaluation membership.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted evaluation membership, schema, historical record, or lifecycle authority is changed; rollback removes only the current Toolchain admission-rejection guard.

slice_hint.state_transition: A proposed TC-D1 scope change that names an evaluation-set member transitions to a rejected, non-authorizing scope result; TC-D1 evaluation membership remains unchanged.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The isolated evaluation-set-admission fixture is rejected by the Toolchain semantic scope gate, records no admission or promotion, and leaves the evaluation membership unchanged.
